_pack_version_comment: Bumped only when ONNX/HEF bytes change OR a new artifact filename is introduced. Engine release workflow pulls model assets from the `models-${pack_version}` GitHub Release (cut once, reused by every engine cut). Workflow: regenerate ONNX (or compile/pull updated HEF) -> bump this field -> commit -> `gh release create models-v4 --prerelease ...` -> upload models there. Bumping this WITHOUT cutting the matching `models-vN` release breaks the next engine release build. v4 extends the M_HAILO_EP pack to full Hailo-8 model parity: per-size HEFs for yolo26n (640/960/1280), yolo_world_v2_s (640/960), yoloe26_s (640), and dinov2-s-v1 (224). The yolo26n_640_hailo.hef is identical bytes to the v3 yolo26n.hef (public Hailo Model Zoo v2.18.0 compile); all others require operator DFC compile via tools/models/gen_*_hailo.py and ship with sha256=PENDING_COMPILE + requires_compile=true until the operator regenerates them. See /memories/repo/nexus-models-manifest-pending-compile.md and tools/models/README.md §'Hailo HEF compilation'.

models._comment: YOLOv26-nano. As of v0.1.19 the engine ships three STATIC-shape ONNX exports — yolo26n_640.onnx, yolo26n_960.onnx, yolo26n_1280.onnx — one per supported input size. Static shapes are mandatory for the Intel NPU plugin (which silently falls back to CPU on dynamic-shape models, observed on Lunar Lake k13) and let the OpenVINO blob cache hit on subsequent boots. Per-profile defaults: 640 (iGPU/Hailo), 960 (NPU/dGPU); override per-camera to 1280 for plate/face detail. The legacy `yolo26n_dynamic.onnx` is deprecated and no longer shipped — regenerate with `python tools/models/gen_yolo26n.py --all-static` before tagging a release.

artifacts._comment: M_HAILO_EP — Hailo-8 compiled artifact for yolo26n_640. Source: Hailo Model Zoo v2.18.0 (https://hailo-model-zoo.s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/ModelZoo/Compiled/v2.18.0/hailo8/yolo26n.hef), renamed to the `<id>_<size>_hailo.hef` convention. 640x640 RGB888 in / raw multi-output (no on-chip NMS). License chain: Hailo Model Zoo MIT + Ultralytics Apache-2.0 + COCO CC-BY-4.0. Loaded by `nexus-hailo-backend` when `inference.ep_priority` contains `"hailo"` AND this file is present in the resolved model pack.

M_HAILO_EP — Hailo-8 compiled artifact for yolo26n_960. NO public Model Zoo build at this size; operator MUST compile from yolo26n_960.onnx via the Hailo Dataflow Compiler. See tools/models/gen_yolo26n_hailo.py --size 960. Calibration: 1024-image sample of COCO val2017 in [0,1] FP32 RGB. Native chip output mirrors the 640 path (raw multi-output, no on-chip NMS).

M_HAILO_EP — Hailo-8 compiled artifact for yolo26n_1280. Same constraints as 960. The 1280 path is the per-camera UI override for plate/face detail; on Hailo-8 the higher resolution roughly doubles chip latency relative to 640 (still bounded by the 26 TOPS budget). Calibration set as for 960.

presets._comment: Default operating point. Best precision/latency tradeoff on iGPU / Hailo boxes (e.g. Iris Xe). Engine resolves this preset to yolo26n_640.onnx.
Mid operating point. Default on Arc A380 dGPU and Lunar Lake NPU boxes. Engine resolves this preset to yolo26n_960.onnx.

Highest-precision operating point. Opt-in per-camera override for plate / face / small-object work. Quadruples compute vs. 640; only enable on tiers with NPU/dGPU headroom. Engine resolves this preset to yolo26n_1280.onnx.

models._comment: YOLO-World v2 (small) export. As of v0.1.22 the engine ships per-size STATIC-shape ONNXs — yolo_world_v2_s_640.onnx (640 default) and yolo_world_v2_s_960.onnx (960 default). Static shapes are mandatory for the Intel NPU plugin (silent CPU fallback on dynamic shapes, observed on Lunar Lake k13 under v0.1.18–0.1.20) and let the OpenVINO blob cache hit on subsequent boots. Prompts are baked into the graph at export time; per-camera config picks a subset at runtime. Regenerate via `python tools/models/gen_yolo_world.py --all-static` whenever the prompt vocabulary changes — the manifest sha256 values below will refresh and the engine's loader will catch the diff. 1280 is intentionally NOT shipped (overkill for the coarse semantic queries open-vocab is used for); the YOLOE multi-size export is deferred to M3.4 (prompt-set rework).

artifacts._comment: M_HAILO_EP — Hailo-8 compiled artifact for yolo_world_v2_s @ 640. NO public Model Zoo build; operator MUST compile via tools/models/gen_yolo_world_hailo.py --size 640. Prompts are baked into the ONNX as fixed text embeddings at export time (see gen_yolo_world.py), so this HEF is image-only at runtime — swapping vocab requires re-exporting the ONNX AND re-compiling the HEF. Calibration: 1024-image COCO val2017 sample.
M_HAILO_EP — Hailo-8 compiled artifact for yolo_world_v2_s @ 960. Same prompt-baking + recompile-on-vocab-change constraints as 640.

models._comment: DINOv2-S backbone export (Meta facebook/dinov2-small). Powers Phase 5.6 wedge identity graph: per-track 224x224 RGB crop -> 384-dim CLS-token appearance fingerprint. Apache-2.0 weights, LVD-142M curated-public-web training set (no PII targeting). Static batch=1 for NPU/OpenVINO blob-cache hits. Regenerate via `python tools/models/gen_dinov2.py`; the script patches the sha256 below in place and writes the .sha256 sidecar that the engine release workflow downloads from the models-v2 GitHub release.

artifacts._comment: M_HAILO_EP — Hailo-8 compiled artifact for dinov2_s_224 (ViT-S/14 backbone, 384-dim CLS-token output). NO public Model Zoo build; operator MUST compile via tools/models/gen_dinov2_hailo.py. Hailo-8 ViT support is partial — expect <1% top-1 drift on cosine distances vs. the FP32 ONNX path, which may require re-tuning the cloud linker `COSINE_MAX` from 0.40 if you swap to the HEF in the appearance-embedding pipeline (Phase 5.6). Calibration: 1024-image ImageNet val sample @ 224x224 RGB.

presets._comment: Only operating point. DINOv2 ViTs are trained at 224 and the engine doesn't benefit from larger crops for a per-track appearance fingerprint.

presets.name: 224-hef
presets._comment: M_HAILO_EP — Hailo-8 backed appearance embedding. Same CLS-token output (384 floats per crop); expect minor accuracy drift vs. ONNX baseline. See requires_compile.
